sc: It is made by adding clean magebane and red moss to a vial of water.
The augmented abyssal whip is a level 70 Melee main hand weapon created by using an augmentor on an abyssal whip.

The blood-dyed augmented Dark Sliver of Leng is a level 95 Melee off-hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Dark Sliver of Leng (blood), or by using a blood dye on an augmented Dark Sliver of Leng.
Additionally, it can be made by dyeing an undyed version or upgrading a non-elite version.
The augmented Verac's flail is a tier 70 melee two-handed weapon created by using an augmentor on a Verac's flail.
The Baby Yaga's House Bunny appearance token is a token unlock item that can be randomly obtained by redeeming a Skill Pet Bunny appearance token or by opening a mystery egg.

Beach Sand Outfit helmet is the head-slot override component of the Beach Sand Outfit, awarded after handing in a total of 12,500 or more beach sand to Reyna throughout the duration of the 2017 Build A Beach event.
A black tricorn hat is a cosmetic item that can be purchased from Honest Jimmy for 50 pieces of eight.
Players who lose it can obtain another by giving a holy symbol and a mithril hatchet to Turael or, after While Guthix Sleeps, his daughter Spria.
It was obtainable from Hey Presto, the Party Plane wizard, and was used to slay the Party Demon.
It became obtainable again on 8 August 2022 to celebrate the creation of 300 million RuneScape accounts.
It was obtainable by popping party balloons received from Party Pete in exchange for balloon fragments.
The butterflies are obtained by catching the magical butterflies in the Butterfly Swarm event in Wilderness Flash Events.
Four cannonballs were made from each ingot.
Christmas pudding was available during the 2012 Christmas event, during the event, it could be found by catching and looting snow implings, or as possible loot from the Gift of Giving.

Circus (Spectator) Shoes.x: The Circus (Spectator) Shoes are a feet slot cosmetic override that can be obtained through Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza as part of the Circus (Spectator) outfit. They are unlocked alongside their item version.

Colonist's coat (orange).x: The orange colonist's coat is part of the colonist's outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: Crafting catalysts are items that were obtainable from Treasure Hunter.

On 26 November 2014, Mod Obeith stated in a reply to the questioning of the removal of Crafting Catalyst, leather case, gem focus and metal setting from RuneScape completely "Crafting Catalysts have been taken off of TH but the items won from there will not be removed.
They are obtained by grinding hedgehog spines with a pestle and mortar.

sc: The crystal trinket is a reward from Arianwyn for completing Mourning's End Part II.
If the players lose it, they can obtain another one from Arianwyn on the of the altar in Lletya or in the Cadarn district of Prifddinas.

They are obtained by upgrading a pair of tier 70 variants with 2 Hermodic plates, 1 piece of greater ensouled cloth, 1 spool of greater ensouled thread, and 25 miasma runes after the completion of Kili's Knowledge VI (power).
Divine Ichor IV is a tablet obtained from the giant clam in Linbog Village.
The Dominion crossbow is a two-handed crossbow, available as a possible reward from the Dominion Tower.
It is received as a random reward through the reward box determined by how high a player's dominion factor is.
It can be created with 500 codex pages using the lectern.
This version cannot be bought from or sold to other players or the Grand Exchange, but it requires fewer codex pages than the tradeable version, which requires 750 codex pages.

sc: Dragonbane arrowheads were made by smithing dragonbane bars on a Kethsian anvil, requiring level 80 Smithing, producing 75 arrowheads and giving 700 experience per bar.
Dragonbane arrows are now made by casting Tune Bane on bane arrows.
A dry note is an item obtained by drying a sodden note on the nearby washing line in the Garden of Kharid.
The triplets of numbers in the end of the note refer to certain letters found in the book on Baxtorian.

This yields the letters "VTAM", hinting at the next step in the sequence; digging in front of the plaque that has these letters next to Phoenix Gang Hideout to obtain the lockbox with the accompanying note.
It can be bought from Wizard Elriss in the Runecrafting Guild for 36 Runecrafting guild tokens (requiring 50 Runecrafting), or ten of them from Wizard Rinsit for 2,000 Runespan points.

Eastern robe (light blue).x: The light blue eastern robe is part of the eastern outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: Enhanced chronicle fragments are obtained as a result of capturing a chronicle fragment within six seconds of spawning.

Empowering an energy rift will grant a divination boost to the player and will spawn an enriched wisp once the rift is fully empowered; this can be accomplished by offering up to 15 enhanced chronicle fragments (8 if the Abyssal Transit buff from the Memorial to Guthix is active).
The Fanatical Siren Outfit is a cosmetic override that can be unlocked by redeeming a key obtained by purchasing the Fanatical bundle.
A Fletching crate (small) is a possible prize from Squeal of Fortune.
Fremennik sea boots 2 are footwear obtained by completing the easy and medium Fremennik achievements.
They are obtained by talking to Yrsa in the clothing shop in Rellekka, and can be reclaimed from her if lost.
Frost dragon bones are an item dropped by frost dragons inside Daemonheim.
Golden rainbow fish eggs are a reward from Fishing, fishing rainbow fish, used in the Aquarium of a player-owned house.
As a rare reward from fishing rainbow fish (level 38 Fishing required) -- approximately 3 hours on average to get the egg.
They can be bought from Papa Mambo.
Aside from this, it cannot be obtained.

sc: Marmaros ore is a tier 3 ore that can only be obtained while Dungeoneering.
It can either be bought from the Smuggler for 4,000 coins, received as a monster drop or mined from a marmaros rock, requiring level 20 Mining.
The player can still obtain master shards alongside normal shards, and will continue obtaining master shards even if the normal shard stack is capped.
It is therefore recommended to obtain all the necessary shards before handing them in to Hans, or the player will need to target the skill again to be eligible to get more master shards.
Mime top is a clothing item that can be bought from Iffie for 2000 coins.
Formerly, it was a reward for completing the Mime random event.
The mining helmet is an item that can be dropped by cave goblin miners, obtained from chests in Dorgesh-Kaan, or bought at Miltog's Lamps in the Dorgesh-Kaan marketplace.
Players must have completed The Lost Tribe to obtain it, but the quest is not required to equip it.
Nasty rogue gloves were a pair of degradable gloves that could be found by looting corpses in the Crucible.

Ornate Throwing Star.x: Ornate Throwing Star is a main hand ranged weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Ornate Ranged Weapon Pack.
